✅ Changelog
[Mar 28, 2024]

- Supported for new roblox UI.

💡 TIPS
- You can also drive a car using a controller or keyboard in mobile!
- VIP servers are currently free!

⚠️ Attention
- The developer is not fluent in English, so the translation may be incomplete.
- In this game, the player's country is displayed to facilitate interaction between players. (do not discriminate on the basis of country or language, or refer to political issues, as this is a violation of Roblox's terms of use and legally and ethically very problematic.)
